title: Commercial structures matched to the opportunity
subtitle: A valuable project should not fail only because of upfront capital
a11yLabel: Commercial structures matched to the opportunity: customer-funded, lease and PPA, and savings-linked models — with the right structure depending on the case.

options.heading: Customer-funded
options.tagline: Full ownership where capital is available
bullets: Customer owns the asset and the savings
Fastest route where capital is available

options.heading: Lease & PPA
bullets: Lease, hybrid lease or solar PPA

content.note: The structure depends on savings confidence, creditworthiness, asset ownership, risk and duration — no model is promised universally.
